note: Photo drawn at 164 px instead of 160 (a 4 px off aspect ratio): the overlay band grows by 4 and the shade, anchored to top 80, grows with it.
Chip row gap 8 instead of 12 (spacing-2 token instead of spacing-3): the 60 % and 30 % chips move left by 4 and 8 px.
Row inset 24 instead of 20 on the left: all three chips shift right by 4 px.
Caption set at 16 px instead of 17 (body-md instead of body-lg); it keeps its 22 px line and bottom anchor, so only the glyphs shrink.
Line height 22 instead of 24 for the three lines: each line is 2 px shorter, the band 6 px shorter.
Caption with -2 % tracking (0.02 × 17 px) copied from the display style: about 6 px narrower.
Caption Medium instead of Semi Bold.
The 38 % (disabled) line uses the 60 % secondary token: it reads as dark as the line above it.
Chips filled with the neighbouring success token #039855 instead of #12B76A (all three, since the faded ones share the fill).
Chip radius 8 instead of 16: the pill becomes a rounded rectangle.
The 30 % chip is not rendered (e.g. a disabled state filtered out instead of faded).
Caption anchored 16 px from the photo bottom instead of 14: 2 px higher.
Scrim at 30 % black instead of 40 %: the lower half of the photo is visibly lighter and the caption has less contrast.
Caption given a max-width and allowed to wrap: it breaks into two lines and, being bottom-anchored, grows upwards to top 102.
